title: Require One Service Module Router Surface
forbids: a module exposing both router.ts and router/index.ts
why: One reachable router surface keeps module composition deterministic while allowing either a cohesive flat router or a directory of completed leaves and subrouters.
remediate: Keep either module/router.ts or module/router/index.ts with named *.router.ts leaves or subrouters, never both.
message: Each service module must expose exactly one router surface.
